description: Standorte von Onshore-Windenergieanlagen in Deutschland – abgeleitet aus Fernerkundungsdaten (Datensatz) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by zenodo.org. The rapid development of renewable energy sources is a major challenge when it comes to reconciling energy development with competing interests. This underlines the need for precise spatial data to enable effective accounting, management or assessment of compliance with legal requirements. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Locations of onshore wind turbines in Germany – derived from remote sensing data (dataset)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, PlanetScope, Onshore-Windenergie, Windstromerzeugung an Land, Onshore-Windkraft, Windkraft an Land. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. The listing shows 2025-07-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
